1.why: src/TL_Bass.cpp:206 clamp(getVoltage(), -2.f, 2.f) added to BASE_V_DEFAULT -2.75f, 440Hz at 0V

comment: The manual says the output is mono ±5V and "limited to ±5 V"; the code multiplies by 5 and then clamps at ±11.7V (TL_Bass.cpp:256), so a loud note can exceed ±5V and the stated limit is not the one in the build. The decay times of 80ms to 800ms come from DecayEnvelope::trigger in helpers/dsp_utils.hpp:113-122; the manual gives no figures. The DECAY CV is sampled only when a note fires, so moving it during a note does not change that note. The timbre switch is configured with its choice list in the order "2", "1", so the tooltip reads 1 for the upper position, which is also what the panel prints. Every jack is read with getVoltage(), so nothing is polyphonic.
